Try itPause Gazebo: which timer stops

With use_sim_time on, the world was paused, then resumed 4.3 s later with the same command and pause: false:

gz service -s /world/patrol/control --reqtype gz.msgs.WorldControl \
  --reptype gz.msgs.Boolean --timeout 3000 --req 'pause: true'
computer's clock: +0.0 stry it
The timers follow different clocksA create_timer timer follows the simulation: it stopped while Gazebo was paused. A wall timer kept firing, and now() barely moved: 32.892 s, then 32.896 s.
